WITH pairs AS (
    SELECT pa1.player_api_id,
           pa1.date AS earlier_date,
           pa2.date AS later_date,
           pa2.overall_rating - pa1.overall_rating AS rating_jump
    FROM Player_Attributes pa1
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2
      ON pa1.player_api_id = pa2.player_api_id
     AND pa2.date > pa1.date
),
pairs_fast AS (
    SELECT p.player_api_id,
           p.earlier_date,
           p.later_date,
           p.rating_jump,
           t.team_short_name
    FROM pairs p
    JOIN "Match" m
      ON m.date = p.later_date
     AND p.player_api_id IN (
            m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
            m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
    JOIN Team t ON (
            p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11) AND t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
         OR p.player_api_id IN (m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11) AND t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
        )
    JOIN Team_Attributes ta
      ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
     AND ta.date = p.later_date
     AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),
max_per_player AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(rating_jump) AS max_jump
    FROM pairs_fast
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
best_rows AS (
    SELECT pf.player_api_id,
           pf.earlier_date,
           pf.later_date,
           pf.rating_jump,
           pf.team_short_name
    FROM pairs_fast pf
    JOIN max_per_player mp
      ON pf.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
     AND pf.rating_jump = mp.max_jump
)
SELECT pl.player_name,
       br.earlier_date,
       br.later_date,
       br.rating_jump,
       br.team_short_name
FROM best_rows br
JOIN Player pl ON pl.player_api_id = br.player_api_id
ORDER BY br.rating_jump DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        league_id,
        season,
        CAST(shoton AS REAL) AS shoton_val,
        CAST(possession AS REAL) AS possession_val
    FROM "Match"
    WHERE possession IS NOT NULL
      AND shoton IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(possession AS REAL) > 50
),
season_avg AS (
    SELECT
        league_id,
        season,
        AVG(shoton_val) AS avg_shoton,
        CAST(SUBSTR(season,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS season_year
